describe.description: Read the monitor: source, roster, nominal band, open session. Says if readings are simulated.

presence.description: Who is aboard: the occupants of every module and what each one is doing now (sleep, rest, light_work, heavy_work, or unknown). The crew's activity is where the cabin's CO2 load comes from; the occupants are who a change of the air, or a test on a volume, exposes.

monitor_start.description: Open monitoring over the people in these modules for a procedure. Refused if a session is open or the modules are empty.

monitor_stop.description: Close the session. Returns the record.

report.description: Gateway relays one strap reading: bpm and beat intervals.

state.description: Monitored subjects: last rate, band, status (nominal, out-of-band, signal-lost).

verdict.description: One line for an abort list. This slot stops nothing itself.

move.description: Put a subject in a module. Scenario control.

alarm.title: Raise a critical health alarm
alarm.description: A critical health alarm for one person, raised by someone who saw it. It stays until cleared: a test that exposes the person stops, and no procedure may expose them meanwhile.

alarm_clear.title: Clear a health alarm
alarm_clear.description: The person is safe: the alarm is cleared by someone who says so.
